d:
The Hawks defeated the Nets, 124-121 tonight in Atlanta. Jalen Johnson contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 7 rebounds and 6 assists, with Nickeil Alexander-Walker of the Hawks adding an additional 20 points (7-17 FG, 2-9 3P) in the game. Michael Porter Jr. finished with a team-high 25 points along with 9 rebounds for the Nets in the losing effort. The Hawks improve their record to 7-4 with the win, while the Nets fall to 2-7 for the season.
